categorisation: The gazette content is an order under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, declaring the application of the Act to a specific international treaty. It deals with the legal framework for international cooperation in criminal matters, including investigation, prosecution, and asset confiscation. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which covers new regulations, statutory instruments, and the implementation of laws. While it names a minister, it does so in the context of executing a legal power and does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities or announce a personnel change, so government Types 1-3 do not take precedence.
